How to use this guide

  1. Choose a map or category to see its location list and bell references.
  2. Choose “View on map” to locate an item on the native map or floor plan.
  3. Load your .sav file to compare completed, missing and unverified entries. Your file is read locally in your browser.
About this data

Location counts follow this tool’s catalogue. Bell distances are straight-line references; entries without a map projection remain in the list.
